description: One keyset page of Zone (REST API guideline 3).

items.description: A behavioral classification scoped to a Site, bundling the Area and Zone code segments into one aggregate.

zoneId.description: `SITE-AREA-ZONE` — the first three segments of every LocationCode inside it.

siteCode.description: The Site this zone is scoped to.

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.

hazmat.description: Whether the zone is rated for hazardous materials.

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.

bayPitchM.description: The zone's effective bay pitch (ADR-0017): the explicit override when one was set at registration, else the service default (1.2 m). Used only by the travel graph's estimated-distance fallback when aisle centreline geometry is missing.

levelPitchM.description: The zone's effective level pitch (ADR-0017): the explicit override when one was set at registration, else the service default (1.5 m). Used only by the travel graph's estimated vertical spacing between adjacent levels.

gln.description: A GS1 Global Location Number (ADR-0045): 13 digits whose last digit is the GS1 mod-10 check digit of the first twelve (weights 3 and 1, alternating from the right). The pattern only checks the shape; the check digit is verified by the service (422 `invalid-gln`). A GLN identifies exactly one site, zone or slot (409 `gln-already-assigned`). Optional everywhere; omitted when none was recorded.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; absent on the last page.
